title: Umsebenzi kwiSixeko Samandulo
intro: Idolophu yamandulo enothuli, abantu bayo bagxile ekukhanyeleni, kwaye isilumkiso sokugqibela esingathotyelwanga. Namhlanje, ngena kwindima yabo bathunywe ngu-Allah ukuhambisa umyalezo kubantu abaneenkani. Ibali lokulahlwa, ilizwi elilodwa lokholo, kunye nesiphelo esitywinwe ngumyalelo otshabalalisayo. Ngubani othetha ngezi zikhokelo?
clues: Sathunyelwa nguAllah kwisixeko esinabantu baso ababeyishiyile inyaniso.
Ababini kuthi beza kuqala, kwaza kwalandela owesithathu ukuqinisa umsebenzi wethu
Abantu basedolophini basilahlile, besithi singabantu abafana nabo.
Umphefumlo omnye ovela kude kakhulu kwesi sixeko wabaleka ukuya kuxelela abantu ukuba basilandele.
Sabacenga, kodwa bazenza lukhuni iintliziyo zabo baza basijikela
Kwisikhalo esinye esibuhlungu esivela emazulwini, isixeko sethu sonke sathi cwaka

trial.label: Uvavanyo/Isiganeko
options: Ukungafunwa nokubizwa ngokuba ngamaxoki ngabantu basedolophini
Kunyanzelekile ukuba basebenze nzima ukwakha intsika ende
trial.answer: Ukungafunwa nokubizwa ngokuba ngamaxoki ngabantu basedolophini

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Umlawuli okhohlakeleyo kunye nomkhosi wakhe batshoniswa kulwandle olwahlulwe phakathi
Imvula yamatye evela esibhakabhakeni yatshabalalisa isixeko

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
